abandoned.ex: The club abandoned its old website last year.

noteJa.meaning: 激しい怒りや敵意；とげとげしさ。

acrimony.zh: 激烈爭吵；不歡而散（end in acrimony）

advocacy.en: public support for a group or cause

necessity.ex: Sleep is a necessity, not a luxury.

not.ex: The plan is not ready yet.

part.zh: 立場（for his part：就他而言）

plug.en: electrical connector; (pull the plug) to stop something

pointed.en: showed with a finger; blamed (point the finger)

paragraphs: World leaders met in Antalya, Turkey, for the COP31 climate talks. The talks ended with no agreement. Many people wanted a strong plan.
Ireland's Climate Minister, Darragh O'Brien, led the EU team. The EU said no to the final plan. The plan did not mention fossil fuels like oil, coal and gas.
Many countries and groups agreed with the EU. They said a deal without fossil fuels would be a joke.
Other people were angry with the EU. They said it did not give enough money to poor countries. Mary Robinson, a former Irish president, said leaders failed. The UN chief was very disappointed.
sentZh: 世界領袖們在土耳其安塔利亞舉行COP31氣候會談。
會談最後沒有達成協議。
很多人希望有一個強有力的計畫。
愛爾蘭氣候部長達拉・歐布萊恩率領歐盟團隊。
歐盟拒絕了最終的計畫。
這份計畫沒有提到石油、煤和天然氣等化石燃料。
許多國家和團體同意歐盟的做法。
他們說，一份不提化石燃料的協議會是個笑話。
其他人則對歐盟感到不滿。
他們說歐盟給貧窮國家的錢不夠。
愛爾蘭前總統瑪麗・羅賓森說，領袖們失敗了。
聯合國秘書長感到非常失望。

paragraphs: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has ended without an agreement. Talks on a deal called the Antalya Pact broke down two days after the official deadline, and world leaders made no new promises to fight global warming.
The European Union refused to accept the final text because it did not mention fossil fuels. It did not say that coal, oil and gas cause climate change or that the world needs to move away from them.

The EU team was led by Ireland's Minister for Climate, Darragh O'Brien. He told the summit that the EU would not accept a deal that made fossil fuels look green. Many countries and campaign groups supported him.

Not everyone agreed. Some aid groups, including Trócaire, said the EU was not giving enough climate money to poorer countries. Former Irish president Mary Robinson said the summit showed a shameful lack of leadership.
The draft deal had admitted that the world has already passed the 1.5°C limit set in Paris. UN Secretary-General António Guterres said he was deeply disappointed.
sentZh: 在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的COP31氣候高峰會沒有達成協議就結束了。
名為《安塔利亞協定》的協議談判在正式期限過後兩天破裂，世界領袖們沒有做出任何對抗全球暖化的新承諾。
歐盟拒絕接受最終文本，因為它沒有提到化石燃料。
文本沒有說煤、石油和天然氣造成氣候變遷，也沒有說世界需要擺脫它們。
歐盟團隊由愛爾蘭氣候部長達拉・歐布萊恩率領。
他告訴高峰會，歐盟不會接受一份把化石燃料粉飾成環保的協議。
許多國家和倡議團體都支持他。
並不是每個人都同意。
包括Trócaire在內的一些援助團體表示，歐盟給較貧窮國家的氣候資金不夠。
愛爾蘭前總統瑪麗・羅賓森說，這場高峰會顯示出可恥的領導力不足。
協議草案曾承認，世界已經超過了巴黎協定所訂的攝氏1.5度上限。
聯合國秘書長安東尼奧・古特瑞斯說他深感失望。

paragraphs: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has collapsed without agreement, after negotiations on the proposed Antalya Pact broke down two days past the formal deadline. World leaders left without making any new commitments to tackle global warming.
The deal fell apart after the European Union objected to a draft that made no reference to fossil fuels, their role in driving climate change, or the need to transition away from them.

The EU delegation was led by Ireland's Minister for Climate, Energy and the Environment, Darragh O'Brien, who told the summit the bloc would not accept an outcome that 'greenwashes' fossil fuels. His stance was backed by a broad group of countries and campaigners.

However, some aid agencies accused the EU of hypocrisy over climate finance for poorer nations, while others blamed the Turkish presidency, a close ally of Saudi Arabia. Former president Mary Robinson described a shameful lack of leadership.
The draft text had acknowledged that the 1.5°C threshold agreed in Paris has already been exceeded. UN Secretary-General António Guterres said he was deeply disappointed.
sentZh: 在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的COP31氣候高峰會未能達成協議而破局，擬議中的《安塔利亞協定》談判在正式期限過後兩天破裂。
世界領袖們離開時，沒有做出任何應對全球暖化的新承諾。
協議破局的原因是，歐盟反對一份完全沒有提到化石燃料、化石燃料在推動氣候變遷中的角色，或是必須轉型擺脫化石燃料的草案。
歐盟代表團由愛爾蘭氣候、能源與環境部長達拉・歐布萊恩率領，他告訴高峰會，歐盟集團不會接受一個替化石燃料「漂綠」的結果。
他的立場獲得一大群國家和運動人士的支持。
然而，一些援助機構指責歐盟在給較貧窮國家的氣候資金上虛偽，其他人則歸咎於土耳其這個主席國，它是沙烏地阿拉伯的親密盟友。
前總統瑪麗・羅賓森形容這是可恥的領導力匱乏。
草案文本曾承認，巴黎協定所議定的攝氏1.5度門檻已經被超過。
聯合國秘書長安東尼奧・古特瑞斯說他深感失望。

paragraphs: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has ended in acrimony, with negotiations on the so-called Antalya Pact abandoned two days after the formal deadline had lapsed. World leaders departed without a single new pledge to curb global warming.
The talks foundered when the European Union balked at a draft that omitted any mention of fossil fuels, their part in fuelling the climate crisis, or the imperative to transition away from them.

It fell to Ireland's Minister for Climate, Energy and the Environment, Darragh O'Brien, who headed the EU delegation, to pull the plug. He told delegates the bloc would not countenance a summit that 'greenwashes' fossil fuels, a stance that won plaudits from a diverse coalition of states and campaigners.

Yet the EU did not escape censure. Aid agencies accused it of hypocrisy over climate finance, while others pointed the finger at the Turkish presidency, a close ally of Saudi Arabia. Former president Mary Robinson lamented a shameful dearth of leadership and urgency.
Tellingly, the draft had conceded that the 1.5°C threshold enshrined in the Paris Agreement has already been breached. UN Secretary-General António Guterres professed himself deeply disappointed.
sentZh: 在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的COP31氣候高峰會在一片激烈爭執中收場，所謂《安塔利亞協定》的談判在正式期限已過兩天後遭放棄。
世界領袖們離開時，沒有做出任何一項遏止全球暖化的新承諾。
當歐盟拒絕接受一份完全未提及化石燃料、化石燃料在助長氣候危機中所扮演的角色，或轉型擺脫化石燃料之迫切必要的草案時，談判便觸礁了。
結果由率領歐盟代表團的愛爾蘭氣候、能源與環境部長達拉・歐布萊恩出面喊停。
他告訴與會代表，歐盟集團不會容許一場替化石燃料「漂綠」的高峰會，這個立場贏得了由各國和運動人士組成的多元聯盟的讚揚。
然而歐盟也沒能逃過譴責。
援助機構指責歐盟在氣候資金上虛偽，其他人則把矛頭指向土耳其這個主席國，它是沙烏地阿拉伯的親密盟友。
前總統瑪麗・羅賓森感嘆領導力與急迫感極度匱乏，令人汗顏。
耐人尋味的是，草案曾承認《巴黎協定》中明訂的攝氏1.5度門檻已遭突破。
聯合國秘書長安東尼奧・古特瑞斯表示自己深感失望。

paragraphs: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, concluded without an agreement, as negotiations on the proposed Antalya Pact collapsed two days after the official deadline. Consequently, world leaders made no additional commitments to mitigate global warming.

The breakdown was primarily attributable to the European Union's objection to a draft text that omitted any reference to fossil fuels, their contribution to climate change, or the necessity of a transition away from them.

Notably, the EU delegation was led by Ireland's Minister for Climate, Energy and the Environment, Darragh O'Brien, who stated that the bloc would not endorse an outcome that 'greenwashes' fossil fuels. This position received substantial support from a diverse range of countries and advocacy groups.

Nevertheless, the EU was also subject to criticism: several aid organisations alleged inconsistency regarding climate finance, whereas others attributed the failure to the Turkish presidency, a close ally of Saudi Arabia. Former president Mary Robinson cited a profound lack of leadership.
Significantly, the draft had acknowledged that the 1.5°C threshold established in Paris has already been exceeded, and the UN Secretary-General expressed profound disappointment.
sentZh: 在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的COP31氣候高峰會未達成協議即告結束，因為擬議中的《安塔利亞協定》談判在正式期限過後兩天破裂。
因此，世界領袖們沒有做出任何減緩全球暖化的額外承諾。
破局的主要原因在於歐盟反對一份草案文本，該文本完全沒有提及化石燃料、化石燃料對氣候變遷的影響，或轉型擺脫化石燃料的必要性。
值得注意的是，歐盟代表團由愛爾蘭氣候、能源與環境部長達拉・歐布萊恩率領，他表示歐盟集團不會認可一個替化石燃料「漂綠」的結果。
這個立場獲得許多不同國家和倡議團體的大力支持。
儘管如此，歐盟也遭到批評：幾個援助組織指稱歐盟在氣候資金上立場不一致，其他人則將失敗歸咎於土耳其這個主席國，它是沙烏地阿拉伯的親密盟友。
前總統瑪麗・羅賓森指出領導力嚴重不足。
值得一提的是，草案曾承認巴黎所訂的攝氏1.5度門檻已經被超過，而聯合國秘書長則表示深感失望。
